headline: Invite the public carefully, not loudly.
copy: The waitlist gate lets VedaPath collect pilot interest locally while keeping the product boundary honest: no accounts, no payments, no promise of production access.
boundary: This is browser-local interest capture only. Production waitlist needs consent, privacy notice, export controls, and account security.

segments.label: Curious learner
segments.need: Ask simple source-backed questions without feeling judged.

segments.label: Teacher or guide
segments.need: Show source category and boundaries clearly.

segments.label: Reviewer or scholar
segments.need: Inspect citations, rights, and answer restraint.

segments.label: Founder pilot
segments.need: Validate demand and trust posture before backend build.

gates.title: No live authority
gates.copy: Pilot copy must say prototype and source-backed, not guru or final answer.

gates.title: No hidden storage
gates.copy: Local browser memory stays visible and clearable.

gates.title: No payment pressure
gates.copy: Public pilot interest comes before monetization.

gates.title: Reviewer route
gates.copy: Serious source issues become review tickets before public use.
